title: ADS BOX Footage Selection Guideline
summary: Pixabay footage is used only for these 8 editorial categories, searched with Pixabay's own category filter, reviewed on contact sheets, and chosen per scene with a written reason. If no clip fits, the scene keeps its approved ADS BOX animation.
rules: Search 5-10 results per scene when available; choose the clip that best matches the narration, not the first result.
Never use the same clip in two scenes.
Avoid nature, animals, fashion shows, random city views, night skies, unrelated industry, religion, politics, sports.
Never force footage into a scene: if nothing fits, use the approved animation and infographic template.
Prefer high quality (1080p or better) that crops cleanly to 9:16; avoid watermarks, heavy on-screen text and distracting visuals.
Every chosen clip has a written reason that ties it to the narration.
A Footage Selection Report (scene, narration, visual concept, category, Pixabay category, keywords, selected clip URL, reason) is made before rendering and sent with the preview.
